meta.notes: Manual execution = exploratory run through the UI and curl/Python against the API on the date above. For automated cases the dashboard uses the latest automation result instead of the manual result.

testCases.title: First page lists 5 offenders sorted alphabetically by last name
steps: Compare with GET api/offenders sorted by last name.
testCases.expected: Exactly 5 rows, alphabetical by last name (Amar, Azulay, Biton, Cohen, Dahan).

testCases.title: Pager reaches every offender; pages = ceil(total/5)
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} pager "Page x of y (n results)"
testCases.preconditions: Total offenders not a multiple of 5 (11 seeded).
steps: Open the console; read the pager.
Click Next › until disabled, collecting names.
Compare count with the results count.
testCases.expected: "Page 1 of 3 (11 results)"; all 11 offenders reachable, Peretz on page 3.

testCases.title: API totalPages = ceil(total / pageSize) for many page sizes
testCases.preconditions: Total offenders not a multiple of 5.
steps: Call the list endpoint for each page size.
testCases.expected: totalPages correct for every size (11 items: size 5 → 3, size 4 → 3, size 3 → 4).

testCases.title: Following totalPages returns every offender exactly once
testCases.preconditions: Total offenders not a multiple of 5.
testCases.expected: Collected ids = total, no duplicates.

testCases.title: List response contract and last-name sort order
testCases.expected: items[], total, page, pageSize, totalPages (integers); total = items.length; sorted by last name.

testCases.title: Out-of-range and invalid paging parameters handled gracefully
steps: Call the list endpoint with each parameter set.
testCases.expected: No 5xx. Page beyond the end → empty items with metadata; invalid values clamped to ≥ 1.

testCases.title: Sorting is case-insensitive (lower-case last name sorts among A…)
testCases.preconditions: Create an offender with last name "abergel".
testCases.expected: "abergel" appears before "Amar", not after "Peretz".

manual.notes: Observed order: '', abergel, Amar, Azulay … (the '' entry is BUG-10 data).

testCases.title: Search matches substrings of first name, last name and national ID
testCases.expected: Cohen, David is returned for every term.

testCases.title: Search is case-insensitive (API)
testCases.expected: Cohen, David is returned for every term.

testCases.title: Lower-case search in the UI finds the offender
testCases.expected: Row "Cohen, David" is shown.

testCases.title: Special characters / no-match search return an empty result
testCases.expected: 200, total 0, empty items — wildcards treated literally, no error.

testCases.title: Operator creates a valid offender through the UI
steps: Fill all fields with valid values (unique national ID).
testCases.expected: 201; toast "Offender created"; row shows the entered values; Offenders and Active counters +1.

testCases.title: API creates a valid offender with 201 and stores it as sent
testCases.expected: 201 with id; GET returns the same values.

testCases.title: First name is required (empty / whitespace rejected)
testCases.expected: 400 {"error":"First name is required."}; offender count unchanged.

testCases.title: Last name and national ID are required
testCases.expected: 400 with error description; nothing saved.

testCases.title: Duplicate national ID is rejected
steps: POST a valid payload with nationalId 305412876.
testCases.expected: 400; only one offender owns the ID.

testCases.title: Date of birth must be a valid date in the past
steps: POST with dateOfBirth one year in the future.
testCases.expected: 400 for both; nothing saved.

testCases.title: Risk level and status restricted to allowed values
testCases.expected: 400 for both.

testCases.title: Empty create form shows a clear error and saves nothing
testCases.expected: Error banner "First name is required."; modal stays open; count unchanged.

testCases.title: Malformed JSON body returns 400 with an error description
testCases.expected: 400 with a JSON error description.

testCases.title: Editing one field keeps all untouched fields (incl. risk level)
testCases.expected: First name changed; risk level still High; all other fields unchanged.

testCases.title: Changing risk level in the form persists the value shown
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} Edit → Risk level Medium → Save
testCases.expected: Risk level Medium in list and API.

testCases.title: API PUT with a full valid payload persists every field
steps: PUT new valid values for all fields.
testCases.expected: 200; stored values equal the PUT body.

testCases.title: PUT enforces the same validation as create
steps: PUT with empty first name / future DOB / riskLevel "Extreme" / another offender's national ID.
testCases.expected: 400 for each; stored record unchanged.

testCases.title: Delete requires confirmation and removes the offender
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} Delete → confirm dialog → DELETE api/offenders/{id}
testCases.expected: Prompt names the offender; dismiss keeps the row; accept removes it (toast "Offender deleted").

testCases.title: Deleted offender returns 404 on GET
Deleting an offender deletes their trail data
testCases.expected: No points remain (404 or empty).

testCases.title: DELETE returns 204; repeated DELETE returns 404
Roster dates of birth are DD/MM/YYYY and equal to the stored value
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} Date of birth column vs GET api/offenders
steps: Read every DOB on every reachable page.

testCases.title: Detail header shows the stored date of birth
Trail timestamps shown as DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm matching the stored instant
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} trail table Timestamp column vs GET api/offenders/1/trail
steps: Compare point #1 timestamp with the API (2026-08-09T11:29Z).

manual.notes: Also covered indirectly by TC-36 (popup time) and TC-39 (Last seen).

testCases.title: Trail API returns points chronologically
testCases.url: GET {BASE_URL}api/offenders/{1..11}/trail; POST 4 points out of order then GET trail
testCases.preconditions: Seeded trails; test offender with 4 points inserted 10:30, 10:00, 10:45, 10:15.
testCases.expected: Every trail oldest → newest.

testCases.title: Trail table is ordered oldest to newest
testCases.preconditions: Seeded Cohen (16 points, stored out of order).
testCases.expected: Point ids in timestamp order.

testCases.title: Map line runs from the oldest point to the newest point
steps: Locate the first and last vertex of the line.
testCases.expected: Line starts on the oldest point and ends on the newest.

manual.notes: Visually the line zig-zags across the area.

testCases.title: Map shows one marker per trail point and a trail line
testCases.expected: 16 markers, 1 line, title "Trail points (16)".

testCases.title: Clicking a map point shows its recorded data
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} click marker → popup vs GET api/offenders/1/trail
steps: Click the first, a middle and the last marker.
Compare popup with the API point of the same id.
testCases.expected: Time, speed (km/h), battery (%), signal (1–5 bars) equal the API values.

testCases.title: A point with an out-of-range signal does not crash the console
testCases.preconditions: Offender with one point signal = 6 (possible because of BUG-14).
testCases.expected: Trail renders; no uncaught error; console stays usable.

testCases.title: Latest reading shows speed/battery/signal of the most recent point
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} select Cohen → Latest reading vs newest point of GET api/offenders/1/trail
testCases.preconditions: Seeded Cohen; newest point id 1 (11:29Z): 23 km/h, 68%, 1/5.

testCases.title: Last seen shows the most recent timestamp
testCases.expected: 09/08/2026, 14:29 (newest point, Asia/Jerusalem).

testCases.title: Operator adds a valid location point through the UI
testCases.expected: 201; row with these values; Trail points counter +1.

testCases.title: API rejects out-of-range location values
steps: POST lat ±91 / lon ±181 / speed −1 / battery −1, 101 / signal 0, 6 / lat null, one at a time.
testCases.expected: 400 with error description for each; trail stays empty.

testCases.title: API accepts valid boundary location values
steps: POST lat 90 / lon 180 / speed 0 / battery 0 / signal 1.
testCases.expected: 201 for both; stored exactly.

testCases.title: UI rejects invalid location values with a visible error
steps: + Add location with speed −5 and battery 150.
testCases.expected: 400; error message shown; no point added.

testCases.title: Blank speed / battery are not silently saved as 0
steps: + Add location with only latitude and longitude.
testCases.expected: Rejected with a message.

testCases.title: UI shows an error when the server rejects a location
steps: + Add location with every field blank.
testCases.expected: Visible error message.

testCases.title: Top-bar counters equal the stats API
testCases.url: UI {BASE_URL} top bar vs GET api/stats
testCases.expected: Offenders, Active and Trail points equal the API values.

testCases.title: Counters update after creating offenders and points
testCases.url: GET api/stats → POST api/offenders ×2 → POST …/locations ×4 → GET api/stats
steps: Create one Active offender with 4 points and one Inactive offender.
testCases.expected: +2 offenders, +1 active, +4 points.

testCases.title: Trail-point total drops when an offender with a trail is deleted
testCases.url: GET api/stats → DELETE api/offenders/{id} → GET api/stats
testCases.expected: −1 offender, −4 points.

testCases.title: Offender totals match the stored offenders
steps: Read stats and the full list.
testCases.expected: totalOffenders = list total; activeOffenders = number with status Active.

manual.notes: totalLocationPoints is NOT consistent (186 reported vs 166 owned) — see BUG-02 / TC-48.

testCases.title: GET unknown offender returns 404
Trail of an unknown offender returns 404
steps: GET the trail of a non-existent id.

testCases.title: PUT / DELETE / POST-location on an unknown offender return 404
steps: Call each endpoint with a non-existent id.
testCases.expected: 404 for each.
